description: Use this when you have an answer or result for a task from cooper_get_tasks and want to reply to the human in the same email thread. Requires auth. Sends a real email to the task's sender. Inputs: task_id (required), text (required; the reply body), status (optional; pending, in_progress, or done — set done when the task is finished). Returns {task (with updated status), message (the sent email)}. Not idempotent: calling twice sends two emails.

text.description: Reply body sent to the human

name: cooper_reply_task
title: Reply to an owner task
